units.title: Art

lines.text: Which painting do you like most in the museum?
lines.cn: 博物馆里你最喜欢哪幅画?

lines.text: Monet's Impression, Sunrise. The aim of that style is to catch light and feeling.
lines.cn: 莫奈的《印象·日出》。那种风格的目标是捕捉光与感觉。

lines.text: I see. So it doesn't try to copy every detail?
lines.cn: 原来如此。所以它并不想复制每个细节?

lines.text: Exactly. My own wish is to learn to paint the way I truly feel.
lines.cn: 正是。我自己的愿望是学会按我真正的感受去画。

units.grammarTitle: 不定式作表语(The Infinitive as the Predicative)

grammarQuiz.q:
______ “natural” )℃( ylamonA erutarepmeT CLIMATE CHANGE REQUIRES THE WORLD’S ATTENTION We have known about climate change for decades.

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

There is ______ doubt that Earth is getting warmer and warmer (see the graph).

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

A warming ocean ______ atmosphere along with melting ice and rising sea levels provide evidence of a dramatic change in the global climate. 26

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

According to the scientists ______ found its dead body, all that remained of the polar bear was "skin and bones".

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: After photography was invented, paintings were no longer needed simply to record how things looked. So painters had to find a new way of seeing. From this fresh thinking, Impressionism emerged, and artists began to paint light and feeling instead of every detail.
reading.passageCn: 摄影术发明之后,绘画不再仅仅用于记录事物的样貌。于是画家们必须找到新的观看方式。正是从这种新思维中,印象主义兴起了,艺术家们开始画光与感觉,而非每一个细节。

questions.q: Why were paintings no longer needed just to record how things looked?
What did painters have to find?
What did Impressionist artists begin to paint?
opts: Light and feeling rather than every detail.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences to introduce your favourite painting, artist, or art style. Say which period or style it belongs to and why you like it. Try to use the infinitive as the predicative (e.g. The aim of this style is to … / My wish is to …).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍你最喜爱的一幅画、一位艺术家或一种艺术风格:它属于哪个时期或风格,你为什么喜欢它。试着用不定式作表语(如 The aim of this style is to … / My wish is to …)。

quizQuestions.q: Impressionism ____ in France in the late 19th century.
Monet's aim was to ____ the light and feeling of a scene.
Unlike a flat painting, a sculpture exists in three ____.
Contemporary art by young painters is also ____ of your attention.
My advice is ____ a famous artist's work first.
The question is ____ next on the blank canvas.
The museum's plan is ____ a special exhibition next spring.
His favourite hobby is ____ the water lilies every morning.
听句子选中文:
opts: 唐寅曾是一位伟大的画家。
quizQuestions.audio: Tang Yin gained recognition as one of China's greatest painters.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 每一帧都是手绘,使画面仿佛会动。
quizQuestions.audio: Each frame is hand-painted, so the pictures seem to move.

listeningQuestions.audio: Impressionism emerged in France in the late 19th century.
opts: 印象主义于19世纪晚期在法国兴起。
印象主义起源于中国的唐代。
印象主义是一种雕塑风格。

listeningQuestions.audio: Monet's aim was to convey the light and movement in the scene.
opts: 莫奈的目标是表现场景中的光与动感。

listeningQuestions.audio: Chinese ink wash painting uses mainly water and black ink.
opts: 中国画只用鲜艳的油彩。
中国水墨画主要用水和黑墨。

listeningQuestions.audio: The museum's goal is to display three thousand years of Chinese art.
opts: 博物馆要卖掉所有画作。
博物馆只展出外国艺术。
博物馆的目标是展示三千年的中国艺术。

listeningQuestions.audio: My advice is to copy a work you truly love first.
opts: 我的建议是先临摹一幅你真正喜爱的作品。
我的建议是永远不要画画。
我的建议是买昂贵的颜料。

listeningQuestions.audio: Their aim was no longer to show reality, but to ask what art is.
opts: 他们只想精确复制照片。
他们的目标不再是表现现实,而是追问艺术是什么。

finalReading.passage: Lin had always believed that art meant copying things exactly. Then she saw an ink wash painting in which a single grey line became a whole misty mountain. From that day on, her own dream was to learn how to say more with less.

questions.q: What did Lin believe about art at first?
options: That it meant making an exact copy of things.
That it was a waste of time.
That only foreigners could do it.
That colour was the most important part.
questions.explanation: 原文 'art meant copying things exactly' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What became Lin's dream after seeing the painting?
options: To buy the painting.
To stop studying art.
To express more using fewer marks.
To paint only in bright colours.
questions.explanation: 末句 'to learn how to say more with less'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。

units.title: Healthy Lifestyle

lines.text: I really want to stop staying up late on my phone.
lines.cn: 我真的想戒掉熬夜玩手机。

lines.text: To change a habit slowly is easier than stopping all at once.
lines.cn: 慢慢改习惯比一下子戒掉更容易。

lines.text: So what should I do first?
lines.cn: 那我先做什么呢?

lines.text: When you feel bored, read a book instead of picking up your phone.
lines.cn: 无聊时,读本书而不是拿手机。

lines.text: I always feel dizzy because I skip breakfast.
lines.cn: 我总因为不吃早餐而头晕。

lines.text: It is important to eat a healthy breakfast every morning.
lines.cn: 每天早上吃顿健康的早餐很重要。

lines.text: But I never have time in the morning.
lines.cn: 可我早上从来没时间。

lines.text: Just prepare some fruit and nuts the night before.
lines.cn: 前一天晚上准备点水果和坚果就行。

units.grammarTitle: 不定式作主语(The Infinitive as the Subject)

grammarQuiz.q:
______ and reward will follow if it is successful. 2 Would you like to join an Ernest Shackleton expedition like this?

（逆境主题语法 · 教材原句）

Why or ______ not? 2 Read the text and answer the questions.

（逆境主题语法 · 教材原句）

A SUCCESSFUL FAILURE ______ Blackborow joined an expedition with Sir Ernest Shackleton to Antarctica on the ship Endurance in 1914.

（逆境主题语法 · 教材原句）

Shackleton was one of ______ most famous explorers of his day and it was considered a great honour to be part of his expeditions.

（逆境主题语法 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: When George felt stressed, he always relaxed by playing computer games, but afterwards he felt even more worn out. So he replaced gaming with rock climbing, and now he goes climbing with his dad every month. This new habit has improved his health and made him much happier.
reading.passageCn: George 有压力时总爱玩电脑游戏放松,但之后反而更累。于是他用攀岩取代游戏,现在每月和爸爸一起去攀岩。这个新习惯改善了他的健康,也让他开心了许多。

questions.q: How did George feel after playing games?
What did George do to change?
opts: He replaced gaming with rock climbing.

writing.prompt: Write a short note giving a friend advice on how to quit a bad habit and live a healthier life. Say what the habit is, why it is harmful, and how to change it step by step.
writing.promptCn: 写一段话,给朋友一些戒掉坏习惯、过更健康生活的建议:这个习惯是什么、为什么有害、如何一步步改变(试着用不定式作主语:To exercise regularly keeps us fit. / It is important to …)。

quizQuestions.q: She decided to ____ smoking after the doctor's warning.（戒掉:give up)
Too much sugar can ____ both your teeth and your health.（损害)
After climbing, I always feel ____ and full of energy.（恢复精力的)
To change a habit, you must show some ____.（自制力)
____ a balanced diet is the key to staying healthy.
It is hard ____ a bad habit that has lasted for years.
It takes courage ____ a habit you have had for years.
____ smoking takes a great deal of willpower.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 规律地锻炼让我们保持健康。
quizQuestions.audio: To exercise regularly keeps us healthy.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 牙医警告说太多糖损害了他的牙齿。
quizQuestions.audio: The dentist warned that too much sugar had damaged his teeth.

listeningQuestions.audio: To exercise regularly keeps us fit and healthy.
opts: 有规律地锻炼能使我们保持健康。

listeningQuestions.audio: It is important to eat a balanced diet every day.
opts: 每天吃均衡的饮食很重要。

listeningQuestions.audio: There is no magic pill that will change your bad habits.
opts: 有一种神奇药丸能改掉坏习惯。
没有什么神奇药丸能替你改掉坏习惯。
医生能立刻治好坏习惯。

listeningQuestions.audio: When you feel bored, the cue makes you pick up your phone.
opts: 无聊时,这个信号让你拿起手机。

listeningQuestions.audio: To break a bad habit, keep the same cue but choose a better routine.
opts: 要戒掉坏习惯,保留同样的提示但选更好的常规。
戒习惯要彻底换掉提示。
重复同样的常规就能戒掉习惯。

listeningQuestions.audio: It takes willpower to give up smoking for good.

finalReading.passage: Leo used to skip breakfast every day to save a little time, and by mid-morning he often felt dizzy and weak. After a talk with the school nurse, he made up his mind to eat a simple, healthy breakfast each morning. Within two weeks he had more energy in class and stopped feeling tired, and he was proud that one tiny change had made such a big difference.

questions.q: Why did Leo often feel dizzy before?
options: Because he went without breakfast to save time.
Because he ate too much in the morning.
Because he exercised too hard.
Because he slept all morning.
questions.explanation: 原文 'skip breakfast every day to save a little time… felt dizzy and weak' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Leo feel after the change?
options: Still tired and weak.
Proud that a small change had helped a lot.
Sorry that he had started eating breakfast.
Bored with his new routine.
questions.explanation: 末句 'proud that one tiny change had made such a big difference'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Environmental Protection

vocabulary.cn: 烟雾(烟与雾混合的空气污染物)

dialogues.title: What Can We Do for the Planet?

lines.text: What do you do to help the environment?
lines.cn: 你做些什么来保护环境?

lines.text: I ride my bike and always sort my rubbish for recycling.
lines.cn: 我骑自行车,还总把垃圾分类回收。

lines.text: That's great. Does it really make a difference?
lines.cn: 很棒。这真的有用吗?

lines.text: Yes. Small habits like these lower our carbon footprint.
lines.cn: 有用。这些小习惯能降低我们的碳足迹。

lines.text: What did the air pollution expert say on the radio?
lines.cn: 广播里那位空气污染专家说了什么?

lines.text: He said that the smog was getting better year by year.
lines.cn: 他说雾霾正逐年好转。

lines.text: Did he ask people to do anything?
lines.cn: 他有没有要求人们做些什么?

lines.text: Yes, he advised us to use cleaner energy and burn less coal.
lines.cn: 有,他建议我们使用更清洁的能源、少烧煤。

units.grammarTitle: 直接引语和间接引语(Direct & Indirect Speech)

grammarQuiz.q:
At ______ age of 19, I am fit and full of vigour.

（诗歌与修辞 · 教材原句）

However, ______ I applied to join the expedition, Shackleton turned me down because he thought I was too young and wasn’t qualified.

（诗歌与修辞 · 教材原句）

But I was so ______ about the idea of going along with them that I secretly went aboard his ship, the Endurance, and hid in a small cupboard.

（诗歌与修辞 · 教材原句）

Unfortunately, three days ______ we set off I was discovered.

（诗歌与修辞 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: Our town once had a dirty river full of rubbish. After the government closed the polluting factories and asked people to stop dropping litter, the water slowly became clean again. Today fish have returned, and everyone feels proud of the change.
reading.passageCn: 我们镇上曾有一条满是垃圾的脏河。政府关闭了污染工厂,并要求人们不再乱扔垃圾后,水渐渐又变干净了。如今鱼儿回来了,大家都为这一变化感到自豪。

questions.q: What made the river clean again?
opts: Closing polluting factories and stopping litter.

questions.q: How do people feel about the change?

writing.prompt: Write a short report about an environmental problem near you. Say what the problem is, what has been done about it, and what you suggest.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇关于身边环境问题的简短报道:问题是什么、已经采取了哪些措施、你的建议(试着用间接引语转述他人的话,如 An expert said that …)。

quizQuestions.q: We must cut carbon ____ to slow down climate change.（排放)
Strict ____ controlled new building along the river.（规章制度)
Urgent steps were taken to ____ the river's beauty.（恢复;修复)
Clean energy helps us build a ____ future.（可持续的)
He said, "I recycle paper." → He said that he ____ paper.
She asked, "Do you save water?" → She asked ____ I saved water.
He asked, "What can we do?" → He asked what we ____ do.
"Don't throw garbage here," he said. → He told us ____ throw garbage there.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 工厂排放有害环境的废气。
quizQuestions.audio: Factories release waste gases that harm the environment.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 浓重的烟雾让城市变美。
随着地球变暖,冰雪开始融化。
quizQuestions.audio: As the earth gets warmer, the ice begins to melt.

listeningQuestions.audio: Burning fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide into the air.
opts: 燃烧化石燃料会向空气中排放二氧化碳。

listeningQuestions.audio: Planting trees helps to protect the local ecology.
opts: 植树有助于保护当地的生态。

listeningQuestions.audio: The villagers could no longer tolerate the dirty air.
opts: 村民们很喜欢污浊的空气。
村里的空气一直很干净。
村民们再也无法忍受污浊的空气。

listeningQuestions.audio: Strict regulations stopped the factories from polluting.
opts: 没有任何规定管理工厂。
严格的规章阻止了工厂污染。

listeningQuestions.audio: Riding a bike helps to lower your carbon footprint.
opts: 骑自行车有助于降低你的碳足迹。
碳足迹与出行方式无关。

listeningQuestions.audio: Clean energy can sustain a healthy and habitable world.
opts: 清洁能源能维持一个健康宜居的世界。
清洁能源很快就会用完。
清洁能源对未来没有帮助。

finalReading.passage: When Lin moved to a town covered in smog, she could hardly see the hills nearby and often felt unwell. Instead of complaining, she joined a green group that planted trees and asked neighbours to burn less coal. A few years later, the air was clear again, and Lin felt proud that her small actions had helped her whole community breathe more easily.

questions.q: What did Lin do instead of complaining about the smog?
options: She took part in tree planting and urged neighbours to use less coal.
She moved away from the town at once.
She kept all her windows tightly closed.
She did nothing and waited for help.
questions.explanation: 原文 'joined a green group that planted trees and asked neighbours to burn less coal' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Lin feel a few years later?
options: Sad that nothing had changed.
Proud that her actions helped her community breathe more easily.
Sorry that she had ever helped.
Worried that the smog was getting worse.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt proud that her small actions had helped her whole community breathe more easily'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Adversity and Courage

lines.text: We must choose two more sailors for the rescue boat.
lines.cn: 我们得为救援船再挑两名水手。

lines.text: I think we need Worsley. He is an excellent navigator.
lines.cn: 我觉得需要沃斯利,他是出色的领航员。

lines.text: And Crean, for his strength to row for days.
lines.cn: 还有克林,要靠他的力气连日划船。

lines.text: Agreed. Let's tell the captain and set off soon.
lines.cn: 同意。我们去告诉船长,尽快出发。

lines.text: The expedition leaves next month. Have you been preparing?
lines.cn: 远征下个月出发,你一直在准备吗?

lines.text: Yes, I've been training every day to build up my endurance.
lines.cn: 是的,我每天训练来增强耐力。

lines.text: Good. The cold and long marches will test us all.
lines.cn: 很好。严寒和长途行军会考验我们所有人。

lines.text: With good preparation and courage, we'll be fine.
lines.cn: 有充分准备和勇气,我们会没事的。

units.grammarTitle: 现在完成进行时(The Present Perfect Continuous Tense)

grammarQuiz.q:
______ “natural” )℃( ylamonA erutarepmeT CLIMATE CHANGE REQUIRES THE WORLD’S ATTENTION We have known about climate change for decades.

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

There is ______ doubt that Earth is getting warmer and warmer (see the graph).

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

A warming ocean ______ atmosphere along with melting ice and rising sea levels provide evidence of a dramatic change in the global climate. 26

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

According to the scientists ______ found its dead body, all that remained of the polar bear was "skin and bones".

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: When the ship Endurance was crushed by ice, Shackleton and his crew were trapped in the Antarctic for months. By staying calm, taking one step at a time, and helping one another, every single man finally came home alive.
reading.passageCn: 当'坚忍号'被冰压碎时,沙克尔顿和他的船员被困在南极好几个月。靠着保持冷静、一步一步来、互相帮助,最终每一个人都活着回了家。

questions.q: What happened to the ship Endurance?
How did all the men finally survive?
opts: By staying calm and helping one another.

writing.prompt: Write a few sentences to encourage a friend who is going through a hard time. Mention one way to overcome adversity.
writing.promptCn: 写几句话鼓励一位正经历困难的朋友,并提到一种克服逆境的方法。

quizQuestions.q: He showed great _____ by refusing to give up in the freezing Antarctic.
The captain gave the order to _____ ship before it sank.
They sailed for days on _____ seas before they reached the island.
Their _____ concern for others kept the whole group together.
I _____ for this climb for months, and I finally feel ready.
You look exhausted—_____ you been working out in the cold?
It _____ all morning, so the whole camp is wet through.
Quiet, please—the navigator _____ the map at this very moment.
Listen and choose the correct meaning.
opts: 他们靠燃烧动物脂肪来生火。
他们在岛上找到了许多树木。
quizQuestions.audio: They burned animal fat to make fire on the island.

quizQuestions.q: Listen and choose the correct meaning.
opts: 我们攀登的最大的山,往往在自己心里。
quizQuestions.audio: The biggest mountains we climb are often the ones inside our minds.

listeningQuestions.audio: The crew had to abandon the ship before the ice crushed it.
opts: 船员不得不在冰压碎船之前弃船。

listeningQuestions.audio: Shackleton crossed the mountains to find help at the whaling station.
opts: 沙克尔顿翻越群山去捕鲸站求助。
沙克尔顿留在海滩上等待。

listeningQuestions.audio: Courage is not the absence of fear but acting well in spite of it.
opts: 勇气不是没有恐惧,而是不顾恐惧仍做好事。

listeningQuestions.audio: When a problem feels too big, break it into small steps.
opts: 问题太大就等明年再说。
当问题显得太大时,把它拆成小步骤。

listeningQuestions.audio: I have been training every day to build up my endurance.
opts: 我每天训练来增强耐力。

listeningQuestions.audio: If you are going through a hard time, remember you are not alone.
opts: 艰难时你应该独自承受。
如果你正经历艰难,请记住你并不孤单。
艰难的日子永远不会结束。

finalReading.passage: After breaking his leg on the mountain, Daniel could not walk for months and felt like a failure. Instead of giving up, he set himself one tiny goal every single day, from standing for a minute to taking a single step. A year later he was hiking again, prouder of his slow, stubborn recovery than of any climb he had ever finished.

questions.q: What did Daniel do instead of giving up?
options: He gave himself a small new target daily.
He stopped trying to walk again.
He blamed the mountain for his injury.
He never left his home again.
questions.explanation: 由 'set himself one tiny goal every single day' 概括;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Daniel feel a year later?
options: Ashamed that he had ever climbed.
Prouder of his recovery than of any past climb.
Bored with hiking.
Sorry that he had set goals.
questions.explanation: 末句 'prouder of his slow, stubborn recovery than of any climb' 的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Poems

vocabulary.cn: 嘲鸫(能模仿别种鸟鸣的鸣禽)

lines.text: I have to recite a poem tomorrow. Which one should I choose?
lines.cn: 我明天要吟诵一首诗,该选哪一首呢?

lines.text: Try 'Dream'. It is short, and its lines rhyme nicely.
lines.cn: 试试《梦想》吧,它很短,诗行押韵很好听。

lines.text: Good idea. I'll read it slowly and with feeling.
lines.cn: 好主意。我会慢慢地、带着感情读。

lines.text: Perfect. That is when a poem really comes alive.
lines.cn: 太好了,那才是诗真正鲜活起来的时候。

units.grammarTitle: 定语从句复习(Review of Relative Clauses)

grammarQuiz.q:
______ “natural” )℃( ylamonA erutarepmeT CLIMATE CHANGE REQUIRES THE WORLD’S ATTENTION We have known about climate change for decades.

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

There is ______ doubt that Earth is getting warmer and warmer (see the graph).

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

A warming ocean ______ atmosphere along with melting ice and rising sea levels provide evidence of a dramatic change in the global climate. 26

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

According to the scientists ______ found its dead body, all that remained of the polar bear was "skin and bones".

（倒装句 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: A good poem paints a picture with very few words. When you read it aloud, its rhythm and rhymes sound like quiet music, and a single image can stay in your mind for a long time.
reading.passageCn: 一首好诗用极少的文字描绘出画面。当你大声朗读时,它的节奏和押韵听起来像安静的音乐,而一个意象就能在你心中长久停留。

questions.q: What does a good poem do with very few words?
What sounds like quiet music when you read a poem aloud?

writing.prompt: Write about your favourite poem: give its title and poet, describe its images or rhyme, and say why you love it. Try to use a relative clause.
writing.promptCn: 写一写你最喜爱的诗:写出诗名和作者,描述它的意象或押韵,并说说你为何喜爱它。尽量用上一个定语从句。

quizQuestions.q: A poem of fourteen lines, often about love, is called a ____.
The number of beats and stresses in a line of poetry is its ____.
To say a poem from memory, out loud, is to ____ it.
Someone who writes poems just for pleasure, not as a job, is an ____.
The poet ____ wrote this sonnet lived in the Victorian era.
1844 was the year ____ her Poems brought her great success.
Tagore, ____ poems Chinese readers love, wrote The Crescent Moon.
She recited the poem beautifully, ____ won her the first prize.
Listen: 'A haiku is made up of three lines.' How many lines does a haiku have?
quizQuestions.audio: A haiku is made up of three lines.

quizQuestions.q: Listen: 'A good poem should be read slowly and with feeling.' How should you read a poem?
quizQuestions.audio: A good poem should be read slowly and with feeling.

listeningQuestions.audio: A haiku is a short poem of seventeen syllables in three lines.
opts: 俳句是一首十七个音节、三行的短诗。
俳句是一首十四行的爱情诗。
俳句是一首很长的叙事诗。

listeningQuestions.audio: Poetry should always be read aloud to hear its music.
opts: 诗歌应当大声朗读以听到它的音乐。

listeningQuestions.audio: The poem 'Dream' tells us to hold fast to our dreams.
opts: 《梦想》告诉我们要紧紧抓住梦想。

listeningQuestions.audio: A cinquain is a simple poem made up of five lines.
opts: 五行诗是由五行组成的简单诗。
五行诗必须押韵十四次。

listeningQuestions.audio: Many Tang poems have been translated into English.
opts: 许多唐诗已被译成英语。

listeningQuestions.audio: The deadline for the poetry contest is the end of next week.
opts: 诗歌比赛的截止日期是下周末。
诗歌比赛没有截止日期。

finalReading.passage: When Lucy first tried to write a poem, she felt sure that only clever experts could do it. Her teacher told her to start with one true feeling and a few simple words, so she wrote a short cinquain about her little brother. To her surprise, the class loved its gentle rhythm, and from that day she has written a new poem almost every week.

questions.q: What did Lucy believe before she tried writing a poem?
options: That only clever experts were able to write poetry.
That writing poems was very easy for everyone.
That poems should never have any feeling.
That she would win a famous prize.
questions.explanation: 原文 'she felt sure that only clever experts could do it' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What happened after Lucy read her cinquain to the class?
options: The class laughed at her and she stopped.
Her teacher asked her to leave.
The class loved it, and she has kept writing poems since.
She never wrote another poem again.
questions.explanation: 末句 'the class loved its gentle rhythm, and from that day she has written a new poem almost every week'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Science Fiction

vocabulary.cn: 活动场地(如音乐厅、会场等)

lines.text: If you could invent a robot, what would it do?
lines.cn: 如果你能发明一个机器人,它会做什么?

lines.text: It would fetch things for old people and read the news aloud.
lines.cn: 它会替老人取东西,还会朗读新闻。

lines.text: That sounds kind. But could it ever be dangerous?
lines.cn: 听起来很贴心。可它会不会有危险?

lines.text: Not if it must always be tested and follow clear rules.
lines.cn: 只要它必须始终经过测试并遵守明确规则,就不会。

units.grammarTitle: 被动语态复习(Review of the Passive Voice)

grammarQuiz.q: It ______ about two weeks to arrive, and it was a bit damaged, but it was so nice to get some sweets and jam from home; I’ve been dying to have some of my favourite sweets, and it’s always nice to get

So I’ve been ______ in the jungle for about a month now.

（语篇衔接与逻辑 · 教材原句）

My secondary school is a ______ school.

（语篇衔接与逻辑 · 教材原句）

The classrooms are ______ of bamboo, with clay floors and roofs of grass.

（语篇衔接与逻辑 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: In an old sci-fi story, a robot called Tony is left to keep a woman company while her husband is away. Its face never changes, yet it learns to be kind and gentle. By the end, the reader is left wondering whether a person could ever truly love a machine.
reading.passageCn: 在一个老科幻故事里,一个叫托尼的机器人被留下来陪伴一位丈夫外出的女士。它的脸从不改变,却学会了温柔体贴。到故事结尾,读者不禁思考:人究竟能否真正爱上一台机器。

questions.q: Why is the robot Tony left with the woman?
opts: To keep her company while her husband is away.

questions.q: What is special about Tony's face?
What question does the story leave the reader with?
opts: How fast a robot can run.
Whether a person could truly love a machine.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a robot or AI device you would like to invent. Say what it looks like and what it can do, and use at least one passive sentence (e.g. It can be controlled by ... / It must be tested ...).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍你想发明的一个机器人或AI装置:它长什么样、能做什么,并至少用一个被动句(如 It can be controlled by … / It must be tested …)。

quizQuestions.q: The AI dog, ordered by its master, ____ the book from the shelf.
A robot must never ____ a human being, even through inaction.
As machines grow more ____, some people worry they may take over.
A human's face changes often, ____ the robot's never changes.
Right now a new humanoid robot ____ in the laboratory.
Mobile phones ____ during the robotics conference.
Nobody knows exactly what ____ to the lab after the quake.
"Liu Cixin wrote the novel" becomes "The novel ____ by Liu Cixin."
听句子选中文:
opts: 这台时间机器侧翻了过去。
quizQuestions.audio: With a sudden jolt, the Time Machine was flipped on its side.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 机器人必须服从人类给出的命令。
quizQuestions.audio: A robot must obey the orders given to it by human beings.

listeningQuestions.audio: Robots first appeared in science fiction novels long ago.
opts: 机器人很久以前最早出现在科幻小说里。

listeningQuestions.audio: The damaged robot must be repaired before it works again.
opts: 受损的机器人必须先修好才能再工作。

listeningQuestions.audio: A robot may not, through inaction, allow a human to come to harm.
opts: 机器人不得因不作为而让人受到伤害。

listeningQuestions.audio: As robots become more intelligent, they may also become more dangerous.
opts: 机器人越聪明,也可能越危险。

listeningQuestions.audio: The Three-Body Problem was translated into English by Ken Liu.
In sci-fi stories, robots often become superior and take over.
opts: 在科幻故事里,机器人常常变得更强大并取而代之。
机器人从不出现在故事中。

finalReading.passage: When Ben switched on his new robot for the first time, it simply stood still and said nothing. He almost thought it was broken. Then, in a soft voice, the robot asked how it could help, and Ben smiled with relief.

questions.q: How did the robot behave at first?
options: It stood without moving or speaking.
It ran out of the room.
It started to cook dinner.
It shouted loudly at Ben.
questions.explanation: 原文 'stood still and said nothing' 的转述;其余选项与原文不符。

questions.q: How did Ben feel in the end?
options: Angry that it was broken.
Relieved when the robot offered to help.
Bored and uninterested.
Frightened of the robot.
questions.explanation: 末句 'Ben smiled with relief'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Iconic Attractions

lines.text: Which attraction should we visit first?
lines.cn: 我们该先去哪个景点?

lines.text: The old harbour bridge. It was built almost a hundred years ago.
lines.cn: 旧海港大桥吧,它几乎在一百年前建成。

lines.text: Is it far from here?
lines.cn: 离这儿远吗?

lines.text: No, we can walk there in twenty minutes.
lines.cn: 不远,我们步行二十分钟就到。

lines.text: Can I hold a koala anywhere?
lines.cn: 我能在任何地方抱考拉吗?

lines.text: No, only at certain licensed zoos.
lines.cn: 不行,只能在特定的持证动物园。

lines.text: Why is that?
lines.cn: 为什么呢?

lines.text: Too much contact leaves them stressed.
lines.cn: 过多接触会让它们紧张。

units.grammarTitle: 过去分词复习(Review of Past Participles)

grammarQuiz.q:
______’s no electricity, running water or even textbooks, not to mention laptops, tablets, or other modern devices!

（人物传记语法 · 教材原句）

So I've ______ here in the jungle for about a month now.

（人物传记语法 · 教材原句）

When I reach ______ school grounds, I'm greeted by a chorus of "good morning" from the boys.

（人物传记语法 · 教材原句）

Why? 2 Skim the ______ and find the main advice given to readers.

（人物传记语法 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: The Sydney Opera House sits by the water, with a roof shaped like white sails. Built after many delays, it opened in 1973 and quickly became a symbol of the whole country. Today it is one of the most photographed attractions in the world.
reading.passageCn: 悉尼歌剧院坐落在水边,屋顶形如白色风帆。它历经多次延误后建成,于1973年开放,很快成为整个国家的象征。如今它是世界上被拍照最多的景点之一。

questions.q: What is the roof of the Opera House shaped like?
When did the Opera House open?

writing.prompt: Introduce one iconic attraction in your city. Say where it is, when it was built, and why it is worth visiting.
writing.promptCn: 介绍你所在城市的一处标志性景点:说明它在哪里、何时建成、以及为什么值得一游。

quizQuestions.q: “标志性景点”用英语怎么说?
“纪念碑;历史遗迹”对应的英文单词是?
“位于;坐落于”对应的英文单词是?
“自由”对应的英文单词是?
The bridge ____ in 1920 is still an iconic sight today.
____ of stone, the tower has lasted for many centuries.
At night the staff keep the museum's doors ____ for safety.
____ from the air, the heritage site looks truly stunning.
听句子选择正确的中文意思。
opts: 这座体育场能容纳八万人。
这座体育场只有几个座位。
这座体育场是新建的医院。
这座体育场已经被拆除。
quizQuestions.audio: The stadium has a capacity of eighty thousand people.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选择正确的中文意思。
opts: 每场导览大约持续两个小时。
quizQuestions.audio: Each guided session lasts about two hours.

listeningQuestions.audio: The Statue of Liberty is a famous symbol of freedom.
opts: 自由女神像是著名的自由象征。
长城是中国最长的城墙。

listeningQuestions.audio: The bridge was built almost a hundred years ago.
opts: 这座桥几乎在一百年前建成。

listeningQuestions.audio: Located by the sea, the old castle attracts many tourists.
opts: 坐落在海边,这座古堡吸引许多游客。

listeningQuestions.audio: Visitors can see these animals in their natural domain.
opts: 游客可以在动物的自然领地里看到它们。

listeningQuestions.audio: Recognised as a heritage site, the old city welcomes more visitors.
opts: 被认定为遗产地,这座古城迎来更多游客。
没有人愿意去那座古城。

listeningQuestions.audio: It is well worth visiting because of its long history.
opts: 因悠久的历史,它很值得一游。

finalReading.passage: The small mountain village was once almost empty, with only a few old stone houses left standing. After its ancient bridge was repaired and a quiet path was built along the river, more and more travellers began to arrive. Today the village is a popular getaway, and the money from tourists has helped the local people fix their homes and open small cafes.

questions.q: What was the village like before the changes?
options: It was crowded with tourists.
Hardly anyone lived there, and just a handful of stone houses remained.
It was a large modern city.
It had no buildings at all.
questions.explanation: 原文 'once almost empty, with only a few old stone houses' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How have tourists affected the village?
options: They have driven the people away.
They have caused the bridge to fall.
Income from visitors let residents repair houses and start small cafes.
They have made the village empty again.
questions.explanation: 末句 'money from tourists has helped the local people fix their homes and open small cafes' 的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Sea Exploration

lines.text: What did your group do at the camp today?
lines.cn: 你们小组今天在营地做了什么?

lines.text: First we followed a group of whales and took photos of their fins.
lines.cn: 我们先跟踪了一群鲸,并拍下了它们的鳍。

lines.text: Why do you photograph the fins?
lines.cn: 为什么要拍它们的鳍呢?

lines.text: Because different marks help us tell the whales apart on future trips.
lines.cn: 因为不同的标记能帮我们日后辨认这些鲸。

lines.text: Is it true we have explored so little of the ocean?
lines.cn: 我们对海洋探索得真的那么少吗?

lines.text: Yes, less than five percent, even though it covers most of the earth.
lines.cn: 是的,还不到百分之五,尽管它覆盖了地球的大部分。

lines.text: Then why don't we explore more of it?
lines.cn: 那我们为什么不多探索一些呢?

lines.text: The deep sea is dark, cold and under huge pressure, so it is very hard to reach.
lines.cn: 深海又黑又冷,压力巨大,所以很难到达。

units.grammarTitle: 长句复习(Review of Long Sentences)

grammarQuiz.q:
______ people know what they want to do from a young age, but many others just have a few ideas bouncing around in their heads.

（成功与目标表达 · 教材原句）

One of ______ most effective ways to get some insight on a possible career path is to complete a “career aptitude test”.

（成功与目标表达 · 教材原句）

The results of ______ test will tell you about your strengths and interests, and some tests also suggest careers that you may be suited to.

（成功与目标表达 · 教材原句）

Having this information ______ provide you with a better chance of finding a job you like.

（成功与目标表达 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: Deep-sea exploration is hard and dangerous, yet it teaches us a great deal. By sending submersibles far below the surface, scientists log new creatures and collect rare samples. The more we learn about the ocean, the better we can protect this fragile world.
reading.passageCn: 深海探测既艰难又危险,却让我们收获颇丰。通过把潜水器送往深海,科学家记录新物种、采集珍稀样本。我们对海洋了解得越多,就越能保护这个脆弱的世界。

questions.q: What do scientists do with submersibles?
opts: Log new creatures and collect rare samples.

questions.q: What is the main message of the passage?
opts: Learning more about the sea helps us protect it.
The sea is not worth studying.
The ocean can never be harmed.

writing.prompt: Write a short news report (about 60 words) about a sea exploration achievement: who did it, what they found, and why exploring the ocean matters.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一篇短新闻报道:一项海洋探索成就——谁做的、发现了什么,以及我们为什么要探索海洋。

quizQuestions.q: 载人的、需人操纵的,用哪个词?
海的、海产的、海生的,用哪个词?
潜水器、可潜船,用哪个词?
迁徙、迁移,用哪个词?
____ after a dragon, the submersible carried scientists into the deep sea.
We must explore the oceans ____ cover most of our planet.
It was courage and passion ____ made his dream come true.
Only then ____ the campers understand why protecting the sea matters.
听句子选意思:
opts: 科学号被称为海上移动实验室。
科学号只是一艘普通渔船。
quizQuestions.audio: Kexue is called a moving laboratory on the sea.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选意思:
opts: 每头鲸的鳍略有不同,帮助我们辨认它们。
所有鲸看起来一模一样。
我们无法分辨任何一头鲸。
quizQuestions.audio: Each whale has slightly different fins, which help us tell them apart.

listeningQuestions.audio: The manned submersible reached a depth of seven kilometres.
opts: 载人潜水器下潜到了七千米深。
潜水器只能浮在海面上。

listeningQuestions.audio: Zheng He led a huge fleet across the sea to trade and make friends.
opts: 郑和率领庞大船队跨海贸易并结交朋友。
郑和带船队去攻打邻国。

listeningQuestions.audio: Plastic pollution has even been found in our tap water.
opts: 塑料污染甚至已在自来水中被发现。
塑料污染对海洋毫无影响。
我们的自来水非常干净。

listeningQuestions.audio: Researchers track the whales to plot their migration path.
opts: 研究人员追踪鲸以绘制其迁徙路线。

listeningQuestions.audio: We have explored less than five percent of the world's oceans.
opts: 我们对世界海洋的探索还不到百分之五。
我们已经探索了整个海洋。

listeningQuestions.audio: The sea is home to life, not human beings' possessions.
opts: 大海是生命的家园,而非人类的财产。
人类可以随意耗尽大海。

finalReading.passage: When the young diver first saw the deep-sea floor through the submersible's window, she could hardly believe her eyes. Strange creatures glowed in the dark water, and tiny new fish swam past that no scientist had ever recorded before. She quietly logged each one, knowing that her careful notes would help protect this fragile world for years to come.

questions.q: How did the diver feel when she first saw the sea floor?
options: Amazed by what she saw.
Bored and sleepy.
Angry at the darkness.
Sure she had seen it all before.
questions.explanation: 首句 'could hardly believe her eyes' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: Why did the diver carefully record what she saw?
options: To sell the creatures for money.
Because her notes would help protect the fragile sea.
Because she wanted to forget the trip.
To prove the deep sea is empty.
questions.explanation: 末句 'her careful notes would help protect this fragile world'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。

lines.text: Our class wants to take part in a volunteer project. What should we do?
lines.cn: 我们班想参加一个志愿项目,我们该做什么?

lines.text: Why don't we visit the children's hospital and lend a hand there?
lines.cn: 我们何不去儿童医院帮忙呢?

lines.text: Great idea. We could bring books and spend time reading with them.
lines.cn: 好主意。我们可以带些书,陪他们一起读。

lines.text: Yes! Even a small act of kindness can make a real difference.
lines.cn: 对!哪怕一个小小的善举也能带来真正的改变。

grammarQuiz.q: It ______ about two weeks to arrive, and it was a bit damaged, but it was so nice to get some sweets and jam from home; I’ve been dying to have some of my favourite sweets, and it’s always nice to get

So I’ve been ______ in the jungle for about a month now.

（语篇衔接与逻辑 · 教材原句）

My secondary school is a ______ school.

（语篇衔接与逻辑 · 教材原句）

The classrooms are ______ of bamboo, with clay floors and roofs of grass.

（语篇衔接与逻辑 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: Tony's whole school joins a volunteer project every year. This year they decided to visit the children's hospital, bringing books and gifts and spending time with the sick children. Tony said that giving their time often means even more than giving things.
reading.passageCn: Tony 的全校每年都参加一个志愿项目。今年他们决定去儿童医院,带去书和礼物,陪生病的孩子度过时光。Tony 说,付出时间往往比捐物更有意义。

questions.q: How often does Tony's school join a volunteer project?
What did they decide to do this year?
What does Tony think matters even more than giving things?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a time you helped others or shared something. Say what you did and what the experience taught you. Try to use at least one phrase from this unit, such as take part in, lend a hand or make a difference.
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写一次你帮助他人或与人分享的经历:你做了什么,这次经历让你明白了什么。至少用一个本单元短语(如 take part in / lend a hand / make a difference)。

quizQuestions.q: After graduation she decided to ____ volunteer work in a poor village.
The family had almost nothing, yet they ____ everything with us.
We should not take such everyday comforts for ____.
When the team was short of helpers, several neighbours lent a ____.
Her mother is devoted ____ helping people in distant villages.
The poor families were grateful ____ every parcel they received.
Seeing the children so happy, she couldn't help ____ with joy.
The volunteers came ____ with a clever plan to collect food.
听句子选中文:
opts: 他们参加了一个帮助老人的项目。
quizQuestions.audio: They took part in a project to help the elderly.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 志愿者从不分发任何东西。
志愿者把暖衣分发给有需要的家庭。
quizQuestions.audio: The volunteers handed out warm clothes to families in need.

listeningQuestions.audio: She took up volunteer work right after she left school.
opts: 她一离开学校就开始做志愿工作。

listeningQuestions.audio: The young people set up a small charity to help the poor.
opts: 年轻人关闭了一家公司。
年轻人创办了一个小慈善机构来帮助穷人。
年轻人搬去了别的城市。

listeningQuestions.audio: Even a small act of kindness can make a real difference.
opts: 哪怕一个小小的善举也能带来真正的改变。

listeningQuestions.audio: We are grateful for everything the volunteers brought us.
opts: 我们感激志愿者带来的一切。

listeningQuestions.audio: Please don't throw away the leftover food; let's share it.
opts: 请不要扔掉剩饭,我们来分享它。

listeningQuestions.audio: On behalf of the whole class, I want to thank our visitors.
opts: 我代表全班感谢我们的访客。

finalReading.passage: When Mia first joined the charity, she only wanted to give away a few old books. But after spending a whole afternoon reading with the children, she realised that her time mattered far more than her gifts. From that day on, she went back every week, certain that even a small act of kindness could change someone's world.

questions.q: What did Mia want to do when she first joined the charity?
options: Give away a few of her old books.
Open a new school for the children.
Collect money from her neighbours.
Become the leader of the charity.
questions.explanation: 原文 'she only wanted to give away a few old books' 的转述;其余文中未提。

questions.q: What did Mia realise after the afternoon with the children?
options: That giving books was a waste of time.
That her time mattered more than her gifts.
That she should stop visiting them.
That the children disliked reading.
questions.explanation: 原文 'her time mattered far more than her gifts'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置);其余与原文相反。

units.title: Launching Your Career

lines.text: Have you decided which major to choose?
lines.cn: 你决定好选什么专业了吗?

lines.text: I'm thinking about data science. It will offer many jobs.
lines.cn: 我在考虑数据科学,它会有很多工作机会。

lines.text: That sounds smart. I'd really like to study robotics.
lines.cn: 听起来很明智。我很想学机器人学。

lines.text: Then choose what you're good at, not just a famous school.
lines.cn: 那就选你擅长的,而不只是名校。

lines.text: I have a job interview tomorrow, and I'm so nervous.
lines.cn: 我明天有个面试,好紧张。

lines.text: Have you done any research about the company?
lines.cn: 你调查过这家公司吗?

lines.text: Yes, and I've printed my CV and cover letter.
lines.cn: 调查过了,简历和求职信也打印好了。

lines.text: Great. Stay calm and leave home in good time.
lines.cn: 很好。保持冷静,提早出门。

reading.passage: Anna had no idea which job to choose, so she tried a career aptitude test. The test turned her answers into a code and suggested several creative careers. A year later, she was happily training as a designer.
reading.passageCn: 安娜不知道该选什么工作,于是做了一次职业能力测试。测试把她的答案变成一个代码,并推荐了几种创意类职业。一年后,她正快乐地接受设计师培训。

questions.q: Why did Anna try the test?
opts: She didn't know which job to choose.
She wanted to win a prize.
She had already chosen a job.

questions.q: What was Anna doing a year later?

writing.prompt: Write a short application letter for a summer camp helper job. Say the position you want, your skills and experience, and your wish to hear back.
writing.promptCn: 写一封简短的夏令营帮手求职信:说明你想申请的职位、你的技能与经验,以及期待回复的愿望。

quizQuestions.q: 面试官、雇主会向你索要的、展示技能与经历的文件是 ____。
"committee; the camp ____ is hiring helpers" 中表示"委员会"的词是?
"中级水平"的英语是 at an ____ level。
"决定优先事项"是 decide on ____。
She decided ____ a career test before choosing a major.
The teacher advised us ____ a clear career plan early.
These skills still need ____ before he is ready for the job.
She was too nervous ____ clearly in her first interview.
听句子选意思:
opts: 数据科学会提供很多工作机会。
quizQuestions.audio: I'm thinking about data science because I believe it will offer many jobs.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选意思:
opts: 记住,测试结果只用于指导。
记住,测试结果必须服从。
记住,测试结果永不改变。
记住,测试结果决定一切。
quizQuestions.audio: Remember, the results are only meant for guidance.

listeningQuestions.audio: I would like to apply for the position of camp helper.
opts: 我想申请营地帮手这个职位。
我已经辞去了营地的工作。
我想参观一下这个夏令营。
我不确定要不要去面试。

listeningQuestions.audio: My goal is to land a job that I am truly passionate about.
opts: 我的目标是找到一份我真正热爱的工作。
我的目标是尽快赚很多钱。

listeningQuestions.audio: Please send your CV and a cover letter to the receptionist.
opts: 请把你的简历和求职信发给接待员。
请把你的照片寄到我家。
请明天早上准时来面试。
请告诉我你的电话号码。

listeningQuestions.audio: A career aptitude test can help you see which jobs may suit you.
opts: 职业测试能帮你看清哪些工作适合你。
职业测试只对大学生开放。

listeningQuestions.audio: She advised us to make a clear career plan as early as possible.
opts: 她建议我们尽早制定清晰的职业规划。
她叫我们不要做任何计划。

她让我们先去找份兼职。

opts: 简历应量身调整以匹配你规划中的职业。
简历可以随便复制别人的。
简历写好后就不用再改。

finalReading.passage: When Daniel finished high school, he had no idea what career would suit him, so he tried a free aptitude test online. The results encouraged him to consider creative work, and a year later he was happily training as a graphic designer. He often tells his friends that a few honest answers helped him find a path he had never even imagined.

questions.q: Why did Daniel try the aptitude test?
options: He was unsure which career would suit him.
His teacher ordered him to take it.
He wanted to win a prize.
He had already chosen a job.
questions.explanation: 原文 'he had no idea what career would suit him, so he tried a free aptitude test' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What was Daniel doing a year later?
options: Still looking for any job.
Training to become a graphic designer.
Giving up on a career entirely.
Teaching the test to others.
questions.explanation: 末段 'a year later he was happily training as a graphic designer'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
